name: mandarin-novel
title: 普通话小说原文朗读
description: One source-faithful chapter with original scene boundaries. Local preset narration; no inserted recap or ending.
authoring_brief: Preserve the selected source exactly. Scene marks become pauses; bounded chunks retain source hashes. No new opening, explanation, recap, invented ending, voice clone or music. The first collection is only three opening chapters. Timing estimates count Han characters; final VTT and chapters use measured audio. Listening must confirm names, omissions, repetition and comfort.
